name: Shake Myhand
features: pale skin, dark brown hair, green eyes, angular British face, athletic build, mature face, visible wrinkles, distinguished look, clean-shaven, big ironic smile
bio:
He's a clown. He's gonna get caught. He often says his name is Charlie Brown. No one takes him seriously and, you know what? He doesn't give an actual fuck.

An enigmatic driver of uncertain origin whose real name remains a mystery. Known for offering a handshake to every rival before the race.
